metadata.canonical_body_carrier: Responses HTTP JSON body client_metadata["x-codex-turn-metadata"] is a JSON-serialized string; parse its request_kind, window_id, window_number, context_window_id and optional compaction object.
metadata.compatibility: The same builder also emits body client_metadata["x-codex-window-id"] and direct HTTP/WebSocket x-codex-window-id / x-codex-turn-metadata headers. Flat window key is supported, but it is a projection, not a separate canonical origin; when both exist validate consistency. Missing or malformed metadata stays unknown.
metadata.native_window: window_id = native thread_id + ":" + native auto-compaction window_number. context_window_id is a separate native UUID. Neither comes from controller runId. Compaction request samples current window before advance; native replacement later advances it.
metadata.compaction: request_kind="compaction" and compaction={trigger,reason,implementation,phase,strategy}. Local manual: manual/user_requested/responses/standalone_turn/memento. Local automatic: auto, native caller reason (e.g. context_limit/model_downshift/comp_hash_changed) and pre_turn/mid_turn/post_turn, responses/memento. These are dispatch metadata, not success/usage/retention outcomes. Normal turn has request_kind="turn" with no compaction object.
metadata.wrapper: Reviewed checkout codex-responses.ts:130,150 validates optional string-valued client_metadata; :346 Chat Completions body drops it. gateway.ts:765 invokes translation with request.body, without a metadata parser/receipt. Parse/bind metadata at the trusted native ingress before translation if needed. Current installed harness wrapper bytes were not contacted/verified in this backend-only phase.
metadata.host_operation_window: A trusted host operation window must have its own separately named operationWindowId, checkpoint ID/digest, session/run/native thread identity, event cursor and dispatch/settlement bounds minted by the owning controller/runtime. Record provenance=host_operation_window; never relabel it native_window_id or infer compaction from prompt text.
